MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful addition to my Fire TV setup because it adds a larger screen for video calls and convenient Alexa access.",
    "The smart plug gives me a new use for Alexa by letting me control a lamp, which fits my interest in connected devices at home."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HD or previous-generation Fire TV Stick repeats a job my existing 4K Stick and Fire TV television already handle.",
    "The earbuds and tablet do not address a current need: my recent interest is in home viewing and connected devices, rather than listening or watching on the go.",
    "The smaller displays and speakers have some appeal, but I would choose the Show 8 for its screen rather than buy several devices with overlapping uses."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to recommend more streamers, even when they add little to what I already own.",
    "Alexa compatibility seems to count too heavily by itself; I still need a clear purpose for each additional device."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What I already own matters: an addition needs to offer a useful capability beyond my existing home viewing setup.",
    "I would choose selectively between similar devices, with the larger display serving my current interest better than a smaller screen or a speaker alone."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You understood my interest in connected home devices, but confused useful additions with more devices that repeat functions I already have."
}
